internal.title: Incident Report: Elevated Error Rate in Cart Service Resolved
internal.body:
At 11:33 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered due to a high error rate in the cart service. The investigation identified that the root cause was an error injection caused by the cartFailure flag being set to 50%, which coincided with the spike in errors. This was confirmed by logs showing errors related to cart operations. 

A mitigation action was proposed and executed at 11:53 UTC to disable the cartFailure flag. Following this, the error rate returned to normal levels, confirming recovery.

Other hypotheses such as queue backlog in Kafka and latency issues in the cart service were considered but ruled out based on evidence and metrics.

Timeline:
- 11:33 UTC: Alert received for high error rate in cart
- 11:53 UTC: Diagnosis confirmed error injection due to cartFailure flag
- 11:53 UTC: Flag disabled after approval
- 11:53 UTC: Recovery verified with error rate normalization

Please review the postmortem for detailed analysis and lessons learned.
